title: Mall World locations
content: A list of reoccurring places I venture to during my Mall World visits: -The Mall -Crystal/trinkets store (cool hippie vibes, old husband and wife owners.) -Bookstore (always looking up epic fantasy books) -Clothing store (awesome subculture costumes) -Grocery store (located in the bottom level at beginning of mall. Very 1980s ShopRite feel) -Department store (large multi level) -Food court (Escher like, loud/busy, no one eating) -Lots of walking, passing by many stores, some open, some closed. I always know where I'm going in the mall, it just takes a long time and energy to get there. Some places are highly populated, others are completely empty. I never recognize anyone there. -Big Bright ascending escalator at center of Food court (portal out of mall) The Resort -Lobby elevators (bright red velvet carpet, gold finishings/doors, dark wood walls, scary fast, some have glass views of outside [high above beach front], brings you to upper level rooms) Upstairs: -Dark hallways, dark room. (There's also a back stairwell that leads to School/University realm.) The hotel rooms are lit by small tvs. Large window. When I look out I always see an apocalyptic scene. I'm always waiting forcsomeone to return. Top Floor: -Movie Theater (2 different concession stands to the right of theater doors, always almost closed with few choices of food left.) Theater is always packed. People being loud, I know everyone but I don't recognize them. It feels like a family reunion. Everyone's talking, laughing, moving around but also paying attention to the screen. I recall the lights turning on at the end, occasionally in the middle the movie and everyone exits together en masse. I never recognize the movies we're watching, but it feels like daily life reviews of someone in the crowd. We're all there to cheer and jeer their actions. -Fancy Restaurant/Buffet (Just around the corner from the theater area on the left. Restaurant has surrounding windows and views of the outside.) Food always looks so yummy. I remember collecting plates of food but never eating it. From here I always venture to the boardwalk. -Boardwalk (Beach with receding shoreline, heavy winds, creepy eclipse like light, build up to giant tsunami wave approaching. I recall running back inside most times and waiting for the water to smash through the restaurant glass, other times I recall being hit with the water when I'm standing on the beach unable to climb the eroded sand) Downstairs: -Casino (small, mostly card tables, with a central old timey heavy wood ornate bar) there's also a couple of pool tables and a two lane small bowling alley. -Arcade (dark, broken machines, mostly empty) -Hallway to live animal exhibit (museum like) -Outside Pool (Always about to close for evening. Large outside, very lagoon like with orange skies.) Transportation: (bringing us all back) There's different modes of transportation to leave the dream. -The Subway (I remember turnstiles and spinning door entryways, rushing down maze like staircases, looking up at signs for my train location, multiple platforms, sometimes having to hop over tracks to get to your correct platform. Lots of people waiting to get on, but empty trains to accommodate us all.) -Bus (I never recall the bus depot, but I recall looking for a seat. I'm always usually sitting in the back area. The journey seems long because my fellow riders and I become like family, sleeping on the bus and getting familiar with one another. Again, no one I recognize from waking life. -Car (I don't have a license but when I'm here I can drive back across the bridge to dream version of NYC.) Outside of Mall World Beautiful Mountains, and hills with flowers. A tropical like fjord with beach lagoons. A forest. It's paradise in all forms. I can go on and on... I can map out so much of this world. I've been going there since I was a teenager. Anyone recognize and share these spaces?
